_readme: What's Good Local weekly deals feed for Kauaʻi. Written by the weekly scheduled task; see CLAUDE.md.

deals.name: Duke's Kauai
deals.deal: Burger & Beer Thursday: specialty burger and beer for $27
deals.details: Burger & Beer Thursday runs all day in the Barefoot Bar. The menu also lists Taco Tuesday in the Barefoot Bar, 11 AM to 4 PM.
deals.location: Kalapaki Beach · 3610 Rice St (Kauai Marriott Resort)

deals.name: Jo2
deals.deal: $55 three-course early dinner, Tue-Sat 5-6 PM
deals.details: Three-course set menu served Tuesday to Saturday from 5 to 6 PM, with an optional $12 wine pairing. The regular menu is also available 5 to 9 PM.

deals.name: Kalapaki Joe's Poipu
deals.deal: Taco Tuesday: $1 steak or chicken street tacos, 3-6 PM
deals.details: Tuesday street tacos are $1 each from 3 to 6 PM, three minimum and six maximum per person, with a two-drink minimum and no takeout.

deals.name: Lava's on Poipu Beach
deals.deal: Kids 10 and under eat free with an adult entrée at dinner
deals.details: Children 10 and under get a free dinner with the purchase of an adult entrée. Dine-in only, at dinner from 5 to 9 PM.

deals.name: Mahiko Lounge (Gaylord's at Kilohana)
deals.deal: Happy hour bites: $8 ahi poke bowl, $8 kalua pork sliders, $7 truffle fries
deals.details: Happy hour food is served 3:30 to 4:45 PM. The lounge lists happy hour Monday to Saturday and is closed Sundays.

deals.name: Oasis on the Beach
deals.deal: Wednesday happy hour menu, 3-5 PM: $9.50 sweet potato chips, $12 signature cocktails, $9 house wines
deals.details: Wednesday happy hour menu from 3 to 5 PM with appetizers, $9 house wines and $12 signature cocktails.

deals.name: Hualani's (Timbers Kauai)
deals.deal: Happy hour daily, 3-5 PM
deals.details: Happy hour runs daily from 3 to 5 PM at Hualani's at Timbers Kauai, Hōkūala.

deals.name: Kalapaki Joe's Poipu
deals.deal: $2 draft beer, $2 house wine, $6.99 select cocktails, daily 3-6 PM
deals.details: Happy hour daily 3 to 6 PM, also with $2 off appetizers, $6 fish tacos and $2 coconut shrimp. Food specials carry a two-drink minimum and are not available to go.

deals.name: Kalypso Island Bar & Grill
deals.deal: Happy hour daily 2:30-5:30 PM (Fri until 9 PM); $5 Pacifico draft Thu
deals.details: Happy hour runs daily 2:30 to 5:30 PM and until 9 PM on Fridays. Tuesday is half off bottled wine and Thursday is $5 Pacifico on draft.

deals.name: Lava Lava Beach Club Kauai
deals.deal: Happy hour 3-4:30 PM
deals.details: The menus page lists happy hour from 3 to 4:30 PM.

deals.name: Lava's on Poipu Beach
deals.deal: Happy hour daily, 2-3 PM
deals.details: Happy hour runs daily from 2 to 3 PM.

deals.name: Mahiko Lounge (Gaylord's at Kilohana)
deals.deal: $5 select beers, $6 Hawaii craft beers, $7 house wine, $12 Koloa Rum mai tai
deals.details: Happy hour drinks 3 to 5 PM, Monday to Saturday; the lounge is closed Sundays.

deals.name: Merriman's Kauai
deals.deal: $6 craft beer, $8 well drinks, $10 house wine, $13 mai tai, 4-5 PM
deals.details: Happy hour at the bar from 4 to 5 PM, with $3 off Merriman's craft cocktails and bar bites such as $6 truffle fries.

deals.name: Paco's Tacos Cantina
deals.deal: Happy hour 3-5 PM
deals.details: Paco's lists happy hour from 3 to 5 PM at its Kapaʻa and Poʻipū locations.

deals.name: Red Salt at Koʻa Kea
deals.deal: Pau hana happy hour, 5-6 PM
deals.details: Red Salt lists a pau hana happy hour from 5 to 6 PM.

deals.name: Shutters Lounge (Outrigger Kauaʻi Beach Resort)
deals.deal: $4 off drinks and $7 snacks, daily 5-6 PM and 8:30-9:30 PM
deals.details: Daily happy hour twice a night with $4 off drinks and $7 snacks such as kalua pig sliders and chicken wings. Dine-in only.
deals.location: Outrigger Kauaʻi Beach Resort · 4331 Kauai Beach Dr

deals.name: Blue Dolphin Charters
deals.deal: $10 per person off when booked online 10+ days ahead
deals.details: Booking online at least 10 days in advance takes $10 per person off; the South Shore Sunset Cruise is $115 adult, $100 youth and $85 child with the discount, plus taxes and fees.
deals.location: Port Allen Marina Center · 4353 Waialo Rd 7B, ʻEleʻele

deals.name: Holo Holo Charters
deals.deal: 20% off gift cards through Nov. 30
deals.details: Black Friday sale: 20% off Holo Holo gift cards, offer ends November 30.
deals.location: Port Allen · 4353 Waialo Rd, Suite 5A, ʻEleʻele

deals.name: Kauai Sea Tours
deals.deal: 20% off select tours when booked direct
deals.details: Kauai Sea Tours offers 20% off select tours for direct bookings only.

deals.name: Kipu Ranch Adventures
deals.deal: 30% off for Hawaii residents; 10% off military and first responders
deals.details: Hawaii residents get 30% off with code KAMAAINA and a valid Hawaii ID or driver license. Military, law enforcement, firefighters, EMTs and 911 dispatchers get 10% off with code MAHALO10 and a valid ID.

deals.name: Princeville Ranch
deals.deal: 20% off kama'aina specials
deals.details: Princeville Ranch offers 20% off kama'aina specials on its ranch adventures.

deals.name: Safari Helicopters
deals.deal: $30 off Deluxe Waterfall Safari and Jurassic Canyon Landing tours
deals.details: With code Save30 the Deluxe Waterfall Safari is $279 (from $309) and the Jurassic Canyon Landing is $339 (from $369). Cannot be combined with other offers.
